name: Fighting Style
summary: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

options.name: Archery
options.summary: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

grants.text: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

options.name: Blind Fighting
keyFacts: Still requires the target not to be successfully hidden.
options.summary: You gain blindsight out to 10 feet and can perceive creatures in darkness or invisibility within that range unless they hide successfully.

options.name: Defense
options.summary: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

options.name: Dueling
keyFacts: Requires a melee weapon in one hand.
options.summary: When you wield a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

grants.text: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
keyFacts: Applies to two-handed or versatile melee weapon damage dice.
You must use the new roll.
options.summary: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a two-handed or versatile melee weapon attack, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

grants.text: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice with two-handed or versatile melee weapons.

options.name: Interception
options.summary: When a creature you can see hits a nearby target, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus.

options.name: Protection
options.summary: When a creature you can see attacks a nearby ally, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll while wielding a shield.

options.name: Superior Technique
keyFacts: Refreshes on a short or long rest.
options.summary: You learn one Battle Master maneuver and gain one d6 superiority die that refreshes on a short or long rest.

options.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
keyFacts: You can draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack.
options.summary: You can draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack, and thrown weapon hits gain +2 damage.

grants.text: +2 damage with thrown weapons; draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.shortLabel: Add ability mod to off-hand damage
keyFacts: Applies while fighting with two weapons.
Lets the second attack add your ability modifier to damage.
options.summary: You can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack when fighting with two weapons.

grants.text: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the off-hand attack.

options.name: Unarmed Fighting
options.shortLabel: Improved unarmed damage and grapple pressure
keyFacts: Grappled creatures take 1d4 damage at the start of your turn.
options.summary: Your unarmed strikes deal improved damage, and creatures grappled by you take 1d4 damage at the start of your turn.

grants.text: Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 (1d8 with free hands) + STR; 1d4 to a grappled creature each turn.
